description: Scenario configurations for the amendment telemetry drill. All values are inputs to simulator.py and detector.py; the drill (run_drill.py) reads this file.

metric_definitions.alert_volume: Mean total alerts per run (all rules, all severities), and the mean count per severity.
metric_definitions.detection_latency_flag_ledgers: First primary-rule alert flag ledger minus inject_at, across the runs that detected. Reported as min / median / max.
metric_definitions.false_positive_rate: On normal streams: WARNING- or CRITICAL-severity alerts per 100 flag ledgers across all 5 runs, and the fraction of normal runs with at least one WARNING+ alert.
metric_definitions.true_positive_rate: Fraction of the 5 seeded runs in which the scenario's primary rule fires at least once inside the injection window [inject_at, inject_at+40].

churn.notes: From flag ledger 40, 12 validators go offline; 4 new validators with 50% yes-propensity join 10 flag ledgers later. Online share falls to 41/53 = 77.4%, below the 80% quorum floor.

normal.notes: No anomaly injected. Baseline support about 90% with per-validator yes-propensity 0.85-1.00; every vote arrives in the same flag ledger (lag always 0). Used to measure the false-positive rate.

quorum-drift.notes: From flag ledger 40, support drifts linearly from about 90% to about 62% over 30 flag ledgers, crossing the XRPL 80% threshold first and the PFTL 67% threshold later.

replay.notes: From flag ledger 40 for 20 flag ledgers, 15% of validation messages are duplicated and 5% are stale (sequence number two flag ledgers old).

timing-skew.notes: From flag ledger 40, 8 validators' votes arrive 3 flag ledgers late.
